ambiguities_or_notes: Tolstoy's letter body is French and is translated directly from French; the Soviet edition's Russian translation is translated separately under Editorial notes rather than used as the English base text.
The malformed/unclear French sequence 'si nulement' is not silently repaired; English marks the uncertain element as '[unclear]'.
The manuscript's illegible word in 'à la [1 нрзбр.] souvent' remains '[1 illegible]' in the direct translation even though the Russian editorial rendering interprets the sense as seeing her often.
The final autograph lines '20 April' and bare '18' are preserved. Official volume 59 reproduces them exactly, confirming that the unit is not truncated.
